title: Open restriction of the dualizing product-square exchange
statement:
Fix the finite coefficient conventions [def-trf-coefficient-conventions], $s=\operatorname{Spec}k$ and $A=A_{E,n}$, and let $j:X\hookrightarrow Y$ be an open immersion of separated finite-type $k$-schemes [def-weil-open-immersion, def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties]. Use the constructible exceptional adjunctions of [def-trf-admissibility]. For $Z=X,Y$, let $a_Z:Z\to s$ be the structure map, let $p_{1,Z},p_{2,Z}:Z\times_s Z\to Z$ be the projections, and put $\omega_Z=a_Z^!A_s$ [def-trf-dualizing-complex]. Let
$$B_{Z,M}=(\operatorname{Ex}_{!,a_Z,a_Z}(M))^{-1}:Rp_{1,Z!}p_{2,Z}^*M\xrightarrow{\sim}a_Z^*Ra_{Z!}M$$
use the normalized compact-support exchange of [def-exchange-projection], invertible on these domains by [prop-functor-package](4). Define $\chi_Z:p_{2,Z}^*\omega_Z\to p_{1,Z}^!A_Z$ to be the $Rp_{1,Z!}\dashv p_{1,Z}^!$ transpose of
$$a_Z^*(\varepsilon_{a_Z,A_s}^!)\circ B_{Z,\omega_Z}.$$
Write $J=j\times_s j$. Identify $j^!$ with $j^*$ and $J^!$ with $J^*$ as right adjoints of extension by zero, using the open adjunctions of [prop-exc-open-adjoint]. These open identifications and exceptional and pullback composition give
$$J^*p_{2,Y}^*\omega_Y\cong p_{2,X}^*\omega_X,\qquad J^*p_{1,Y}^!A_Y\cong p_{1,X}^!A_X,$$
where $j^*\omega_Y\cong j^!a_Y^!A_s\cong\omega_X$. Under these specific identifications, $J^*\chi_Y=\chi_X$. No properness of $X$ or $Y$ is assumed.
